summary.text: Mark MacKenzie is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 40, where he assumed office on December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A captain with the Manchester Fire Department, he has also held leadership roles with firefighter and labor organizations.

paragraphs.text: Mark MacKenzie's career experience includes working as a captain of the Manchester Fire Department.
He has served as secretary-treasurer of the Professional Firefighters of NH and as president of the New Hampshire AFL-CIO.
MacKenzie previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 17 from 2016 to 2018, when Heidi Hamer succeeded him.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Hillsborough 40 on September 8, 2026.
